$comment: What UnitPad reads from this package. `format`: the version of this file's own shape; it only grows (a new field is optional), and a package whose format UnitPad does not know is refused at build, not at run. `prelude`: the modules every sheet starts with (a module made of `use` lines is expanded, so one id can stand for many); they are not importable and not listed in the Modules menu. `types`: a module's type is the first part of its path (`throughput::s3` is a `throughput`); the Modules menu lists the types in this order, under these headings, and a type not listed follows, alphabetically, under its name with a capital.
